audit.establishes: that the benches, runners, reducers, pins and documented cold-start invocations of the declared scope are committed, hashed and cross-referenced. It does not establish that any command succeeds, RF compliance, or overall T1.
mechanical_checks: the coverage index parses and every claim carries the required fields and a known classification
every listed path is a tracked, existing file (runners invoked directly are mode 100755)
every sim/<dir>/ is an indexed family or an explicitly named support directory
every tracked non-evidence file in an indexed family is listed by a claim or excluded with a reason
every tracked record, view, corners and netlist-snapshots id in an indexed family belongs to a claim
sim/<slug>/ mentions and standard record ids in the declared claim sources resolve to the index
no tracked bench-like file outside sim/ exists unless excluded with a reason
each bench template is referenced by name from a listed runner, reducer or generator of its claim
each cold-start command appears verbatim in its named document and names a listed runner, reducer, derivation or replay path
each data-only derivation names source claims that exist and have records
every listed input, shared input and record file is hashed (sha256); corner and snapshot trees get a git-blob digest
the PDK pin and the grader pin are read from sim/pdk.json and the workflow
the committed inventory equals the recomputed one byte for byte
the envelope, the manifest citation and the rolling report (when present) bind the same inventory hash
reviewer_checks: run each documented cold-start command on a machine with the stated tools and PDK pin; command text in a README does not prove it succeeds

confirm the classification of each claim (present DUT, historical DUT, nominal exploration, variant exploration, device characterization, data-only derivation) against the record and the DUT of that date
confirm no measurement published in prose, issues or records is missing from the claim sources scanned mechanically (the scan reads only the declared claim_sources, not arbitrary prose)
confirm blocked or unrun benches are described as such and not read as results
confirm historical-DUT claims are not cited for the current design
audit.scope: Every measurement family published under sim/ (records, correction records, nominal explorations, PVT-grid variant explorations, blocked/unrun campaign benches) and the measurements/ summary view derived from them. Device-level studies (HBT, breakdown) are included. Layout, DRC, LVS, design-source and netlist-regeneration checks are other T1 items and are not testbenches. Historical-DUT records are inventoried and labelled but are not reproducible from the current tree. The audit attests shipped, documented, pinned benches; it says nothing about whether the measured circuit meets any spec row.
